4#include "COINAlgebra/Core/DecayVector.h"

6class DecayLevel;
7
8
9class PathProjectors
10{
11public:
12
13    // ========================================================
14    // Constructor
15    // ========================================================
16
17    PathProjectors();
18
19
20    // ========================================================
21    // Source projector
22    // ========================================================
23
24    // Projects a decay vector onto the subspace of
25    // length-one paths having the specified source.
26    //
27    // If
28    //
29    //     d = sum_i a_i p_i,
30    //
31    // then
32    //
33    //     S_s(d)
34    //       = sum_{p_i in P_1}
35    //           delta_{s(p_i),s}
36    //           a_i p_i.
37    //
38    // The coefficients of the retained paths are copied
39    // unchanged from the input vector.
40    //
41    // Only paths of length one are included.
42    DecayVector SourceProjector(
43        const DecayVector& vector,
44        DecayLevel* source
45    ) const;
46
47
48    // ========================================================
49    // Target projector
50    // ========================================================
51
52    // Projects a decay vector onto the subspace of
53    // length-one paths having the specified target.
54    //
55    //     T_t(d)
56    //       = sum_{p_i in P_1}
57    //           delta_{t(p_i),t}
58    //           a_i p_i.
59    //
60    // The coefficients of the retained paths are copied
61    // unchanged from the input vector.
62    //
63    // Only paths of length one are included.
64    DecayVector TargetProjector(
65        const DecayVector& vector,
66        DecayLevel* target
67    ) const;
68
69
70    // ========================================================
71    // Source vertex projector
72    // ========================================================
73
74    // Projects a decay vector onto the stationary path
75    // associated with the specified source vertex.
76    //
77    // The coefficient is obtained by summing the coefficients
78    // of all paths whose source is the specified vertex.
79    //
80    //     V_s,i(d)
81    //       = sum_p delta_{s(p),i} a_p e_i
82    //
83    // where e_i is the stationary path at vertex i.
84    DecayVector SourceVertexProjector(
85        const DecayVector& vector
86    ) const;
87
88
89    // ========================================================
90    // Target vertex projector
91    // ========================================================
92
93    // Projects a decay vector onto the stationary path
94    // associated with the specified target vertex.
95    //
96    // The coefficient is obtained by summing the coefficients
97    // of all paths whose target is the specified vertex.
98    //
99    //     V_t,i(d)
100    //       = sum_p delta_{t(p),i} a_p e_i
101    //
102    // where e_i is the stationary path at vertex i.
103    DecayVector TargetVertexProjector(
104        const DecayVector& vector
105    ) const;
106
107
108    // ========================================================
109    // Branching projector
110    // ========================================================
111
112    // Projects a decay vector onto its stationary-path
113    // subspace.
114    //
115    // For each stationary path e_i already contained in the
116    // vector, its coefficient is retained.
117    //
118    // Equivalently, this selects the length-zero stationary
119    // paths from the vector.
120    DecayVector BranchingProjector(
121        const DecayVector& vector
122    ) const;
123};
